Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally designed high-fidelity desktop public homepage screenshot for Maintainex, a developer's open-source contribution workspace. This replaces a previous generic admin dashboard direction. Reference images: Image 1 is Kaggle CURRENT public homepage for editorial hierarchy, visual confidence and restrained composition; Image 2 is Kaggle CURRENT Code page for consistent components, clear search, understated controls; Image 3 is Deep-ML public homepage for developer typography and a signature technical visual. Use reference DESIGN PRINCIPLES ONLY, do not copy logos, imagery or text.

FIXED PROFESSIONAL COLOR SYSTEM, obey strictly: canvas #101211, surface #181b19, subtle border #303632, primary text #f0f2ed, secondary #a8b1aa, SINGLE ACCENT muted lime #c4e876. Every chart, graphic, icon, badge, avatar and thumbnail must be grayscale or shades of THIS lime. No blue, purple, orange, red, cyan, rainbow badges, fake colorful company logos. Bright lime occupies under 5% of screen. Soft gentle tonal lighting is allowed only in artwork; no glow around controls. One Grotesk sans serif family with a bit of mono only for technical labels. Sharp typography, 8px rhythm, meaningful whitespace, finely aligned baselines, controlled pills on search/buttons, broad clean panels, 8px radii on data rows. Professional and desirable like Kaggle crossed with Deep-ML; not enterprise CRM, not cartoon, not cyberpunk.

Compose a single full width crisp 1920x1400-like page crop, straight-on screen artwork with no physical device, outer presentation frame or browser chrome. Top navigation 72px high: custom text wordmark "maintainex" with tiny lime branch glyph, links Product / Explore / How it works, right Search icon and understated "Sign in". Public-first: NO LOGIN GATE, no signup modal, no premium gate. Headline left at x80 y160 with calm editorial weight and beautiful linebreaks EXACT: "A little progress.\nA lasting contribution." supporting text "Keep your open-source work, context, and next steps together." Primary dark-filled lime text or muted-lime fill black-text pill "Explore Maintainex", secondary understated "See how it works". Small mono label above: "OPEN-SOURCE, IN PROGRESS". Right half: ORIGINAL striking three-dimensional-looking but restrained technical artwork: an elegant pale graphite topographic ribbon made from tightly spaced contour lines, subtly merging into a commit-branch graph, a few muted lime nodes, soft depth, muted lime highlight, black background. Evoke the sophistication of Kaggle's field graphic and Deep-ML's computational pattern without copying either. Artwork must stay separate from content and not obstruct readability.

Below y580 make a full-width real product preview titled "A workspace for the work that matters." small "WORKSPACE PREVIEW · EXAMPLE DATA", tabbar Overview / Activities / Work / Pins, Overview selected via thin lime underline. Preview has a tidy attention queue on left, recent contributions center, narrow This week panel on right; sparse clear task titles "Review keyboard navigation", "Document local setup", "Reproduce a failing test"; owner/repo maintainex/client. Every status is neutral outlined text+icon; lime only selected or completed. No arbitrary metric cards, fake upward arrows, score, ranks or streaks. In preview small Add work button, no login dialog. Bottom small three editorial columns "Capture context" / "Plan the next step" / "Record the outcome" with thin monochrome line icons and one short sentence each. Tiny footer "Design concept · example content". Visually impressive AND plausible to implement as reusable HTML/CSS with one technical SVG/canvas artwork. Large readable text, exquisite spacing, minimal chrome. Image is a conceptual homepage, not proof that anonymous backend data exists.
shared:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an exceptionally polished Maintainex product design board with FOUR full desktop screens in a sharp 2x2 arrangement, large detailed landscape aspect ratio approximately 3840x2800, no perspective, no laptop frames. Use input image 1 (the Maintainex public homepage) as the authoritative BRAND REFERENCE. Image 2 (Kaggle Code) supplies hierarchy, clean search/tabs, calm outlined components and spacious precise typography. These are design references, not edit targets. Carry the first image's exact wordmark, typography, colors, neutral outlined status pills and muted-lime selected states into a professional daily-use application. The brand signature is a fine topographic contour/commit-line fragment, tiny and low-contrast in the right of a SHORT page masthead; NOT a giant hero on utility screens. Avoid a generic admin-dashboard look.

COLOR LOCK: background #101211, surface #181b19, elevated #202521, line #303632, text #f0f2ed, secondary #a8b1aa, single brand accent #c4e876. Use ONLY gray and this muted lime across ALL icons, avatars, charts, status pills, tags, logos and artwork. ABSOLUTELY NO blue, cyan, purple, orange, red, yellow, pink, rainbow symbols, multi-color heatmaps or arbitrary metric colors. Error and blocked states use readable text and icons with neutral borders, not extra hues. Lime less than 5% of area, subtle tonal fills. No gradients, glows, fake upward arrows, giant metric cards or generic placeholder card walls. Beautiful grotesk sans typography, monospace for technical IDs only, fine restrained dividers, 8px spacing rhythm, comfortable 48-56px table rows, primary controls about 40px high, 8px panel radii, modest pills for filters. Crisp high contrast text and aligned layouts.

The consistent app shell has a slim upper brand/search/account bar and a narrow neutral left sidebar: Overview, Activities, Work, Pins, Organizations; bottom Community and Settings. Use matching exact shell across all frames. Highlight only current navigation. Clear breadcrumb on detail views, one primary action per page, real helpful content hierarchy. Sample owner/repo maintainex/client, person Alex Morgan, dates October 2026. No random scores, ranks, streaks, competitions, report/quest/recommendation/opportunity features. Tiny board footer "Design concept · illustrative data". Private records are sample workspace content; never imply anonymous visitors can access personal records. Public site entry does NOT require login; public/private gating details deferred, so do not insert forced login screens into product browsing.

Each frame caption outside product viewport. Do not put design system annotations, implementation jargon or future roadmap placeholders inside product UI. Readable realistic English, sparse sample records, clear primary and secondary actions. These are design specifications and must NOT claim features are implemented.

pages.spec: Frames: A "Overview": personal daily workspace, primary Add work; quiet neutral metric strip In progress 4, Due this week 3, Blocked 1, scope This week; Attention queue grouped tabs Due, In progress, Blocked with 4 readable work rows showing title, repository, next action, textual status, due date; modest Recent contributions section. B "Contribution analytics": title Contribution analytics and time range, one purposeful activity trend chart with labeled dates and units, type breakdown, repository table, clearly scoped sample counts, no fake arrows or unsupported deltas. C "Community": compact feed with author/repository/title/date/source, useful discussion and comment affordance rather than reaction-button wall, no huge empty area, a restrained people-to-follow search link. D "Goals": personal weekly contribution goal list, each has an explicit target, current count, date window and accessible edit, primary Add goal; no streaks, badges or competitions. Show manual vs synced scope accurately.

Frames: A "Activities": mature table, title dominates, repository below title, five columns Contribution / Type / Status / Date / Source; toolbar Search activities, Repository, Status, Date, Clear and count; title direct links; ellipsis actions; 7 sample rows. B "Activity detail": breadcrumb Activities / PR #42; title Improve keyboard navigation; source Manual entry distinct from outcome Submitted; GitHub source link; concise change summary, date, repository, readable event timeline, Edit activity primary; secondary metadata collapsed. C "Record activity": practical form, labels above controls, GitHub URL first with manual entry alternative, title, repository, type/status/date, optional details disclosure, Save activity and Cancel; readable helper text and no irrelevant required fields. D "Edit activity": same layout prefilled, one inline field error tied to a validatable URL, unsaved changes indicator, retained draft, Save changes primary, Cancel and lower-emphasis destructive action in overflow. No unsupported verified claims.

Frames: A "Work list": Work title with Add work; toolbar Search, Status, Repository, Due, List/Board; filters as active chips, 6 rows containing task title and next action, repo, state, due date; clear Overdue marker, completed excluded from due counts. B "Work board": same records and filters in three restrained columns Planned, In progress, Blocked, minimal cards with readable next actions and dates; Move menu on cards as keyboard alternative to dragging; no empty decorative columns. C "Work detail": breadcrumb, title Reproduce keyboard focus bug; large Next action block "Reproduce the failure locally"; source GitHub issue #42; context, notes editor with Saved feedback, blocker "Waiting for test data"; compact status/due sidebar and timeline; meaningful primary Save notes. D "Plan / edit work": shared create-edit form with title, repository, source URL, due date with timezone, status, Next action and optional Blocker, collapsible notes; Add work primary for create, show editing variant in small labeled inset with Save changes; no quest or recommendation references.

Frames: A "Pins": personal reference library using compact rows grouped Recent / Reference; Search pins, Type, Repository filters; title, URL domain, short note, last updated; primary Add pin. B "Pin detail": title Keyboard navigation issue, domain github.com, link, contextual note, tags, primary Plan work, clearly secondary Edit pin; small source preview without fake metadata; indicate that Plan work prefills a task and retains this reference. C "Add pin": practical minimal form URL, title, optional note, type and tags, private visibility label; Add pin and Cancel; manual title fallback. D "Edit pin": same form prefilled, clear save state, Save changes; single understated Archive option with Undo success toast; do not portray permanent deletion as recoverable. No Saved Opportunities or publishing catalogue.

Frames: A "Organizations": compact searchable organization list default with list/grid toggle, one filter disclosure, active technology chip, sort and count; rows show logo initial, name, description, primary stack and synced repository count, no quests or scoring. B "Organization detail": meaningful overview summary, GitHub link, tabs Overview / Repositories / Contributors, readable repository rows, provenance and last synced status; no follow/share placeholders, quests, leaderboards, arbitrary Maintainex scores or save-org action. C "Repository detail": header maintainex/client, GitHub link, descriptive summary, source freshness; contribution activity table, work connected to the repo and clear status; Add work primary prefilled to repository, evidence timeline; no recommendations. D "Search": query keyboard, groups Organizations / Repositories / People / Your work / Your pins, counts, strongly labeled results and clear navigation; a query in input and short matching result previews; no quests, reports or removed routes. Private work identified as Yours.

Frames: A "Settings": real configuration sections GitHub connection with last successful sync and Retry if failed, appearance Dark, notification preferences; viewer read-only notice if relevant; no roadmap tiles or reports; one Save preferences primary. B "Notifications": All/Unread tabs, grouped Today/Earlier, concise event rows with source and timestamp, Read/Unread controls, preference link, mark all read secondary, no promotional notifications. C "Profile": Alex Morgan, contributor bio, GitHub link, privacy-aware real-record section with sample source labels, Contributions / Repositories / About; Edit profile primary for own profile, Followers / Following links; no arbitrary scores, badges or ranking. D "Edit profile and security": clear labeled name, username, bio, public links, visibility; Save changes; security section with Change password link, no exposed credentials; small deliberate password form inset with current/new/confirm, requirements, reveal control and field error, never actual password text.

Frames: A "Sign in": focused calm desktop auth page with Maintainex wordmark, short practical value statement, labeled email/password, show-password, Sign in, GitHub sign in, View as viewer, Sign up link, no fake metrics or decorative hero. B "Create account": matching name/email/password form, inline requirements, Create account, sign in link; clear action and concise disclosure without invented terms acceptance. C "People and connections": searchable People directory with person rows, name/handle/bio and Follow; profile context with Followers/Following tabs using same compact row component; selected Followers state; no ranking. D "Responsive states": three narrow full-height mobile product screens inside this fourth frame, individually labeled Work, No matches, Sync failed: mobile work list with title/status/date and reachable Add work, mobile full-page work detail via obvious open affordance, empty filtered state with Clear filters, error notice with Retry that preserves data; a small Saved feedback and keyboard focus outline example. No mock records presented as actual live data. Usability state showcase, no unexplained blank skeleton screen.
